title: MBountyHunting
description: MBountyHunting allows players to place bounties on their rivals using any item as a reward. Whether it's diamonds, custom items, or simple materials—revenge has never been so rewarding.
body:
✨ Key Features
Offline Support: Set bounties on players even if they are currently offline.

Item-Based Rewards: Use any item in your inventory as a bounty. No economy bridge required.

Performance Optimized: Extremely lightweight code to ensure 0.0ms impact on your MSPT.

Multi-Bounty System: Players can stack multiple rewards on a single target.

Intuitive UI: Clean and simple commands for a seamless player experience.

⚙️ Full Control & Customization

No Watermarks: Your players will never see "MPlugins" in-game. It’s your server, your branding.

100% Configurable: Every message, permission, and setting can be adjusted in the config.yml.

🛠️ Commands

/bounty - Open the GUI

🌐 Connect with MPlugins
Join our community and get the most out of your server.

Website: [https://mplugins.net/](https://mplugins.net/)

Discord Support: dc.mplugins.net

Performance First: All our plugins are optimized for high-player counts.

No Limits: 100% customizable without any annoying watermarks.
